product_mounting_direction_frozen.note: Operator fixed the AMOLED/QMI8658 board to a paper-box temporary fixture. This is repeatable temporary mounting evidence, not final product mounting freeze.

production_fixture_defined.note: Paper-box fixture exists and was used for capture, but it is not a production or lab calibration fixture.

six_face_or_equivalent_accel_calibration.note: Only one mounted static window was captured.

signed_static_gyro_bias_complete.note: Static gyro summary was recorded, but this is not a signed production gyro bias calibration.

temperature_drift_characterized.note: No temperature sweep or drift characterization was performed.

fifo_drdy_interrupt_validated.note: No FIFO/DRDY interrupt evidence was captured.

power_current_waveform_validated.note: No PPK2/Otii or equivalent current waveform was captured.

backend_quality_gate_passed.note: The temporary fixture MQTT capture and M1 quality/replay passed, but final backend quality gate remains pending.

m1_recording_replay_passed.note: M1 recording/replay passed for temporary fixture evidence, not final accepted backend evidence.

recalibration_triggers_reviewed.note: Report keeps final enclosure, mounting, calibration, FIFO/DRDY, and power changes as recalibration blockers.

boundary.notes: Temporary fixture evidence is useful for bring-up and repeatability, but every formal acceptance gate still requires final hardware-observed artifacts.
